description: This file defines the Java class DefaultJavaScriptConfig, which implements configuration parameters for JavaScript mapping, including script size, execution time, and stack depth limits, and provides methods for instantiation, equality checks, and string representation.

classes.name: DefaultJavaScriptConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of JavaScript configuration settings for size, execution time, and stack depth limits.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates an instance of DefaultJavaScriptConfig from a given Config object, applying fallback defaults and validation.

methods.name: getMaxScriptSizeBytes
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed JavaScript script size in bytes.

methods.name: getMaxScriptExecutionTime
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed script execution time as a Duration.

methods.name: getMaxScriptStackDepth
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed script stack depth.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on script size, execution time, and stack depth.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on configuration parameters.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the configuration object.
